editorial:
You know the story: a family moves into a nice suburban house and things go wrong fast. In this 2015 remake, the Bowen family settles into their new home, only to find out it was built on top of an old cemetery. Strange things start happening right away, from flickering lights to creepy clown dolls. The youngest daughter, Madison, starts talking to people who aren't there. Before long, the spirits take her, and the family has to fight to get her back. The vibe is tense and jumpy, with plenty of loud scares and creepy moments that keep you on edge.

The acting is solid, especially from the kids, and the pacing moves quickly without dragging. The special effects look good, though some moments feel a bit too familiar if you've seen the original. On the plus side, it's fun, scary, and easy to follow. On the downside, it doesn't bring much new to the table. If you love haunted house movies, this one is worth a watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the family teams up with a paranormal expert to pull Madison back from the spirit world. They discover the house sits on a burial ground, and the angry spirits are trying to drag everyone into their realm. During a chaotic rescue, the family manages to grab Madison and escape just as the house collapses into a sinkhole. The twist is that the spirits were never truly gone, and the family's new home might not be safe either.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves haunted house horror and jump scares.
